mechanism.scope: whole-M layer-major linear-attention state tiles of exactly C512
mechanism.conv: one exact whole-span causal-conv kernel per layer and C512 tile
mechanism.recurrence: one CTA per value head; two lanes retain a complete BF16 state row and pass one FP32 accumulator after each K8 slice
mechanism.numerics: the K0..K127 FMA order and per-token BF16-RNE state boundary are bit-exact with the retained exact-C16 chain
mechanism.epilogue: existing exact headwise RMSNorm plus SiLU Z gate remains a separate kernel
mechanism.fallback: the existing C16 fused path is unchanged when the explicit run admission is disabled or whole-M selection misses
mechanism.p2048_expected_call_change: 48 linear layers times four C512 tiles: exact GDN calls fall from 6144 C16 calls to 192 C512 calls

real_openai_api_gate.authority: resident real authenticated model, exact token-ID prompts, OpenAI completions, temperature zero, one generated token
real_openai_api_gate.all_requests: HTTP 200, exact usage, generated text Hello

real_p2048_nsys.authority: interactive collection started after the resident server reported ready; exactly one real P2048 request; startup excluded
real_p2048_nsys.finding: The observed 474.06 ms kernel-chain saving explains nearly all of the 497.14 ms unprofiled P2048 latency reduction, and the exact-span kernel appears exactly 192 times.

validation.component: C16, C32, and C512 raw output and final state are bitwise equal to the exact-C16 chain
validation.integrated_component: C512 convolved QKV, conv history, final GDN state, and normalized gated output are bitwise equal
validation.independent_integration_review: no blocker in pointer offsets, state/history continuity, stream order, fallback, or publication

decision.reason: The exact route is bitwise, profile-confirmed, and repeats a 5.1 to 6.5 percent whole-product latency reduction, but P2048 remains 7.0 times below the first throughput target.
